updates.title: Polytetramethylene Ether Glycol From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Sales at Less Than Fair Value
updates.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG) from the People's Republic of China (China) is being, or is likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is October 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.
